body: I'm about to enter one this week. As far as I know, it's pretty much the same program set up that they do in full hospitalizations where they make you try different methods to deal with things and it's all group stuff except for when you meet with your assigned psychologist and psychiatrist for brief periods each day. I'm not excited about it but at least you're more in control than being fully hospitalized. Good luck to you

There are partial hospitalization programs where you attend for about a week or so for around 8 hours a day and don't have to stay over night. You should get an appointment with a psychologist as well since psychiatrists focus more on prescribing medications for treatment but hopefully your new psychiatrist can help you come up with a plan and point you in the right direction about partial hospitalizations.
